prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: BookStark Android Flutter implementation prototype, a single selected image containing two smartphone screen states side by side. Generate a high fidelity crisp UI mockup, not a photograph.
Primary request: extend the existing BookStark notes-list design with honest server-supported filtering and selected-ID bulk pinning. Keep the established white background, slate text, bright blue #2563eb accents, subtle light-gray separators, rounded search/chip surfaces, 24dp page margins, 48dp touch targets, clean Chinese Android typography. Two equal portrait Android screens on a very light neutral presentation canvas, thin device edges, both fully visible. Left is the notes list in multi-select mode. Right is the same notes page dimmed behind a tall scrollable filter bottom sheet. Make all Chinese text carefully legible, restrained hierarchy, no dense explanatory implementation labels, no watermarks.

LEFT screen:
Status bar 09:41. Header "知识库", smaller subtitle "服务器空间"; tabs "笔记" selected, "文章", "待办", "书籍".
Search placeholder exactly "搜索标题或标签" (do NOT say body search).
Filter button "筛选 · 2", blue active chips "公开" and "含代码", secondary "清除".
Selection row "已选 3 项" and small helper "含其他页 1 项", right text action "取消".
Three airy note rows with selection checkboxes, document outline icons, title/snippet/time/tags and overflow:
First checked row title "Dart 异步笔记", snippet "记录取消、超时与资源释放", metadata "今天 09:20", chips "Flutter" and "公开", a small pin icon/status "已置顶".
Second checked row title "阅读工具开发", snippet "代码示例与阅读体验整理", metadata "昨天", chips "开发" and "公开".
Third unchecked row title "每周代码回顾", snippet "本周记录与下一步行动", metadata "周一", chips "复盘" and "公开".
A clear bottom selection action bar above the persistent nav, button "置顶所选", secondary outlined "移到回收站". No select-all-results claim. Bottom nav "首页" "知识" selected "收藏" "文件" "我的". Do not show floating create button over selection actions.

RIGHT screen:
Same page softly dimmed in background. Tall white rounded top-corner bottom sheet with drag handle, title "筛选笔记", close icon. Body is visibly scrollable with a slim scroll indicator.
Sections in order:
"标签": single selector "全部标签" with chevron.
"创建日期": selector "不限日期" and calendar icon (single date, no date range).
"置顶": three wrap chips "全部" selected, "已置顶", "未置顶".
"可见性": three wrap chips "全部", "私有", "公开" selected blue.
"内容": switch ON labeled "仅含代码", muted helper "按现有代码标记筛选".
Bottom sticky sheet actions "重置" outlined and wide blue "应用筛选".
Do NOT invent negative 'no code', custom date range, bulk unpin, sort picker, shared/public equivalence, counts of unselected records, attachment filters, folder filters, or any server implementation promise. The right sheet selection must match the left chips (public + contains code; label/date/pin unlimited).
Exact text clarity matters more than decorative details. Render realistic polished Flutter Material layout, simple outline icons and consistent spacing.
